summary: The documented ERR-MULTI-PARENT-SHARED-WRITER / SHARED_WORKTREE_COLLISION failure reproduced live, unprompted, within two minutes of dispatching five concurrent lanes. This is the same defect recorded against PO-03 as SHARED_WORKTREE_COLLISION_DURABLE, now observed in a fresh group under a different commission.

what_happened.mechanism: Cursor local subagents dispatched from one parent share a single filesystem and therefore a single git working directory at /workspace. Each lane was instructed to run `git checkout -b <its branch> <base sha>`, which each did. They then contended for one HEAD.

observed_evidence.instrument: git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; git branch -v; git worktree list

what_happened.how_it_surfaced: The root controller attempted to amend its own committed group manifest and received FileNotFoundError, because another lane had switched the shared working tree to a branch that does not contain that commit.

why_this_matters: The estate's recorded diagnosis says lessons are documented without changing the mechanism. This is a direct instance: the collision was already known, already named, already written down, and it still recurred immediately in a new group because nothing structurally prevented it. Guidance in a commission document is not a control.
root_cause: Isolation was specified as a branch-level property (each lane owns a branch and a path namespace) when the actual contended resource is the working directory. Branch isolation without worktree isolation is not isolation.
concrete_risks_created: A lane running `git add -A` can capture another lane's untracked files into its own commit.
A lane can commit onto whichever branch another lane most recently checked out, so work lands on the wrong branch.
A lane can observe a partially written tree belonging to another lane and treat it as repository evidence.
Any lane's `git checkout` silently changes every other lane's view of the repository mid-task.
what_did_not_break: Untracked files survive branch switches, so no lane's written output was destroyed by the contention.
Path namespaces are disjoint, so file-level overwrites were not observed.
The root controller's work was already pushed, so the remote copy was authoritative and recoverable.
One lane, OE-L4-CURRENTNESS-RECOVERY, independently created its own worktree at /tmp/oe-l4 and was structurally immune.

mitigation_applied_now.action: The root controller removed itself from contention by creating an isolated worktree at /tmp/oe-root bound to the return branch, and moved its uncommitted work there.
mitigation_applied_now.result: The root controller no longer competes for /workspace HEAD and its shared-projection writes are safe.
mitigation_applied_now.limitation: Running lanes could not be corrected in flight, because a follow-up cannot be delivered to a subagent that is still executing. The remaining lanes continue to share /workspace.

fail_closed_integration_response.rule: Because in-flight correction was impossible, correctness is enforced at integration instead of assumed at dispatch.
checks_the_root_controller_will_apply_be: The lane branch must contain changes ONLY inside that lane's declared owned namespace; any file outside it is cross-contamination and the candidate is rejected.
Every commit on the lane branch must be authored against that lane's branch, verified by walking the branch from the declared base SHA.
The lane's manifest hashes must be recomputed independently from the fetched remote bytes, not trusted.
Two lanes claiming the same file path is an automatic fail-closed rejection of both until adjudicated.
A lane whose branch is missing or empty is recorded as NOT_RETURNED rather than assumed successful.

required_mechanism_change.statement: Lane isolation must be enforced by construction, not by instruction.
changes: Every dispatched lane must be given a pre-created dedicated git worktree path and told to cd into it, rather than being told to run `git checkout -b` in the shared root.
The dispatch contract must forbid `git checkout` and `git add -A` in the shared root outright.
The group manifest schema must carry a `worktree_path` field per parent, and dispatch must fail closed if it is absent.
An executable pre-integration guard must verify namespace containment per lane branch; this is a test, not a guideline.
required_mechanism_change.owner: root controller, folded into the operating-environment programme and handed to the currentness-mechanism lane as live input

reuse_value: This is a reproduction of a real recurring defect with a known-good control, obtained at zero cost to protected surfaces. It should be admitted as reproduction evidence for the error-recurrence matrix rather than discarded as an incident.
